exact_separator.universal_proof: At each site a nonnegative combination of original charge/discharge half-PCS rows yields u_s>=support(Pch,Pdis,Q,stay). The multipliers satisfy sum(w*a)=-1 and sum(w*b)=0 exactly. Every integral trajectory has sum(u_s)<=1-charge_mode. Summing site supports gives the stated inequality, valid for all 4-slot integer trajectories and their convex hull.
